name: People's Militia
summary: In Westfall, the People's Militia holds its ground against the Defias Brotherhood. Gryan Stoutmantle raised the volunteers at Sentinel Hill after Stormwind withdrew its troops. With local farmers and visiting adventurers, they defend the region from banditry.

sections.title: A Region Abandoned
sections.body: Westfall once fed the Kingdom of Stormwind. Then the kingdom withdrew its troops, leaving the people defenseless. The Defias Brotherhood spread across the plains, seizing family homesteads, taking over iron mines, and extorting local farmers. With no royal reinforcements in sight, veteran warrior Gryan Stoutmantle rallied citizens and retired soldiers to form the People's Militia.

sections.title: Holding Sentinel Hill
sections.body: Sentinel Tower, atop Sentinel Hill, is the Militia's base. From there, volunteers patrol the region's main roads with little military gear or steady supplies. Gryan Stoutmantle directs them against the growing ranks of Defias highwaymen, thieves, and pillagers. When Redridge asks for mutual aid, the Militia must refuse. Sending even a handful of men could leave Westfall lost.

sections.title: Uncovering the Conspiracy
sections.body: Scouting and outside help reveal the scale of the Defias threat to the People's Militia. The Brotherhood is more than a band of country thieves. It operates under Edwin VanCleef, the former Guildmaster of the Stonemasons who rebuilt Stormwind. From the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, the Defias plan to overthrow the kingdom. The embattled Militia is the only barrier between the capital and open insurrection.

faq.q: Why is the People's Militia fighting alone without Stormwind's army?
faq.answer: Stormwind withdrew its troops from Westfall, leaving its people defenseless, and no one in the countryside has been told why. Gryan Stoutmantle rallied the People's Militia to defend what remained of the land.
Gryan Stoutmantle, a seasoned human veteran, founded and leads the People's Militia.
The People's Militia is based at Sentinel Hill, around the tall stone watchtower in the heart of Westfall.

faq.q: Can the Militia help other troubled regions like Redridge?
faq.answer: No. When Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire asked for military reserves, Gryan Stoutmantle had to refuse because the Militia was barely holding on against the Defias.

faq.q: Who is the main enemy the Militia fights?
faq.answer: The People's Militia fights the Defias Brotherhood, a criminal syndicate of former masons, rogues, and highwaymen led by Edwin VanCleef.

angles.text: As a human, you see how Stormwind's rural folk defend their homes when the royal court turns a blind eye.
As a warrior, you see Gryan Stoutmantle and his protectors lead from the front. They make do with worn blades and makeshift armor against overwhelming odds.
As an Alliance hero, you see Westfall's crisis expose dangerous cracks in the kingdom and show how fragile peace is in its heartlands.
